chatFlows.label: Attrition pulse
chatFlows.response:
**Attrition is 11.4% — down 0.8 pts on the quarter and the lowest in the 12-month window.** It has fallen every month since the 13.4% February peak that followed bonus payout.

{{chart:trend}}

- Engineering drove the recovery: 15.6% in Feb to 11.9% in Aug, after 41 of 47 L4-L5 stay interviews
- Compensation still drives 34% of exits — the Sep 1 comp review targets exactly that cohort
- August was net +11 heads: 29 starts against 18 exits

> Watch item: Support eNPS is 29 and has trailed every team for 8 months; engagement usually leads attrition by about two quarters.

**Next step:** land the comp review on Sep 1, and take the Feb exit-cohort slide into the 13:00 with Priya Nair.

chatFlows.response:
**Recommendation: approve the $284,000 Staff SWE offer.** It sits 6.0% above the L6 Austin mid ($268K) but under the $290K band max, and the alternative is worse.

1. Candidate holds a competing offer at $295K expiring Monday
2. Req ENG-1187 has been open 74 days — nearly twice our 38-day average
3. James Whitfield cleared it with a CFO note; only your sign-off remains

{{chart:donut}}

Compensation already drives 34% of our exits — losing a closed candidate over 6% sends the wrong signal mid comp-cycle.

> Precedent guard: log it as a one-off exception tied to the competing offer, not a new floor.

**Next step:** approve in Greenhouse before the 15:00 sync so Tomas Rivera can verbally confirm today.
